name: Sardinia
about: Peak summer (Jul–Aug) is hot, crowded, and expensive, especially around Costa Smeralda; May–Jun and Sep–Oct offer the same beaches with a fraction of the crowds.
overview: Some of the Mediterranean's best beaches, ancient Nuragic stone towers found nowhere else on Earth, and the ultra-glamorous yacht scene of Costa Smeralda — one of the world's five Blue Zones, where residents live unusually long lives.
costOverview: Away from Costa Smeralda, Sardinia is one of Italy's better beach values — the yacht-and-celebrity scene up north is where prices go stratospheric.
